reviews.classification: full fold proposal reconciled to existing later explicit uptake
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual145-line review includes FP1–FP6, every donor clause and caution, FS1–FS9, Q1–Q5, explicit unread branches, housekeeping and historical resume command. The opening proposal-only/wait-for-yes statement is superseded within its scope by the existing2026-10-15 user quote in PACKETS added-donors and modular-chain Round6 owners. Those owners already fold section2 donors and explicitly adopt section3 FS1–FS9. This reconciliation does not duplicate that round, allocate codes or renew historical commit/push authority. Other proposed rank/order/worker/launch changes remain unselected.

F2: FP1 preserves actual predicate-bound blockers, rate-qualified ETA, paused work and forecast versus actual outcomes, while donor durable last-result joins remain unshown. Kittens' cap-impossible arithmetic ETA, one global failure-reason slot and silent boolean craft failures are cautions, not patterns to copy. FP2 keeps retained recipe knowledge, page-progress multiplier and direct XP separate; teacher/library/deck/practice routes differ. Sapiens' bounded no-teacher result is not whole-game absence. FP3 distinguishes real spend, eligibility threshold, paid or free prep and retained consequences; a closer exception can beat patience termination, and an unread paid branch supplies no evidence. No universal romance penalty, stress tax or training cap follows.

F3: FP4 shows competing uses joined by actual item identity, not that every item is valid in every destination. No sampled donor's side-by-side destination quote does not prove YAIR is first across all games. Free stock, held inputs, hauling priority, job entitlement and useful return differ. FP5 keeps learned/unlocked/researched/affordable/storage-limited/allowed-worker/permission-to-use-stock/target conditions distinct. Sapiens being the only new sampled permission donor does not establish unique industry support or full ownership simulation. Source data and controlled fixture behavior do not establish current native admission, rendered UX or save recovery.

F4: FS1–FS7 retain stage-specific interrupt/reset/fuel/custody, actual climate predicates, lot-held elapsed change settled before movement, passive versus staffed time, containers, branches and selected part-property transfer. An API offering copy/merge/average does not show which vanilla flags use it. FS8's separate body/gene/health fields need real readers before claiming independent behavior. FS9's evidence unlock is not a correction/revision ledger; retain the bounded research donor distinction. Current AD36/AD38/AD51/AD52 and existing chain owner qualify uptake, with no universal climate, fixed body cap, mandatory manual first run or new scheduler.

F5: All ten feature questions being answered does not make the ten PARTIAL lanes full aspects/runtime/source coverage. Q1–Q5 and old paid-asset/native-launch limits are dated follow-up options; existing later receipts may supersede them. Historical launcher/session/commit instructions are not live work authorization. No source donor, private fixture, executable, save, installed state or current worker was rechecked. Original useful comparisons, negative results and named unread reducers/branches remain preserved.

reviews.reopen: Use already-folded donor evidence for a selected actual gap; no historical lane restart.

reviews.classification: full finite seventy-check audit, preserving source-layer and schema limitations
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual212-line review includes C1–C10 and all70 concrete checks: seven lane families HR/SU/R2/KH/TS/MD/MI, each five S and five I rows.35 structural/source checks plus35 proposed adaptations do not mean70 independent findings, all sources read or whole-lane certification. MD F11 is split, SU F13 supplies three subclaims and HR finding IDs require the file name because REPORT/FINDINGS reuse labels. Original static inspection, textual statement, parsed graph, screenshots, tutorial and inference stay distinct. No referenced private extraction, source body, image, installed game or upstream site was reopened here.

F2: HR's declarations/availability/unlock/adjacency and orb generation versus departing-power drain are different mechanisms. Conditional map-memory guards do not prove all distant history is deleted; an apparent prior-item mismatch remains unproven runtime defect. SU archive/native symbols, localization counts, render-heavy fusion, global trait append and distinct hidden/travel setters do not certify full semantic fusion, trait cap, purchase or return. Encounter termination needs its local mechanism, not a global fixed lifetime cap. Expedition resets cannot substitute for OD5 retained histories.

F3: R2 parsed claims retain unresolved Mappings.usmap build-match risk. Ordered ActivateFirstValidWorld is activation, not recovered randomness. Selected biome tags, hazard exports, archetype references and bark guards do not prove full admission/payment/mitigation/cleanup/arbitration. Third-party SaveGuardian is not engine atomicity evidence. KH member tables, command flags, level/bonus/summon definitions, event/script/resource counts and model overlays do not establish body/controller transition, personal memory, custody, consent or native Steam save compatibility. Preserve selected-artifact scope and unrecounted form rows.

F4: TS tabletop law/form/consumable/gate examples supply source semantics, not software commit algorithms or all-gate support. Shared injury pools and translation are source-specific options alongside suitable unchanged passage, while personal-recursion construction remains unread. MD public room/monster/reset tutorials and website help code are not live server source; hidden exits differ from guarded exits, resets from retained deaths, guild limits from unlimited multiclass and help topics from NPC dialogue. MI screenshots support visible origin filters, costs, layout and labels, not their runtime readers, a dependency graph, parallel maps, offline math, transfer or persistence. Proposed widths summing correctly do not establish readable browser layout.

F5: Retain the useful adaptation questions: same earned capability versus present usability; actual carrier terms; local law with useful outcomes and mitigation; nonduplicated consumables; personal histories and revisit continuity; origin-filtered known-only presentation; true work receipt versus unused allowance. Current AD16/AD38/AD42/AD43/AD51/AD52 and accepted OD owners govern actual clocks, carry and work. C8's1366gate, C10's every-unaccepted-feature Projects placement and earlier roster/milestone/order conventions are dated, not renewed universal gates. Current source owners govern any selected slice; human review is optional, source facts do not require new spending, and none of the70checks is freshly rerun by this document review.

reviews.reopen: For a selected mechanism reopen only its exact source/schema/native gap and existing owner.
